title: Comfort Club Member Benefits on Installations, Duct Cleaning, Repair Guarantees and Protection Claims
content:
Members of Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements receive benefits on Harbison work outside the maintenance visit itself: a credit and an accessory discount on a replacement installation, a duct-cleaning discount, a longer repair guarantee, and, on the upper tiers, a waived claim service fee on a protection contract.

| Tier | Member credit on a replacement installation contract signed while the agreement is active (USD) | Discount on accessories added to an installation contract | Discount on the whole-home duct cleaning task | Months added to the standard repair guarantee | Protection contract claim service fee waived |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 0.00 | 0% | 0% | 0 | No |
| Comfort Club Silver | 150.00 | 5% | 10% | 6 | No |
| Comfort Club Gold | 250.00 | 10% | 10% | 12 | Yes |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 400.00 | 10% | 15% | 12 | Yes |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 500.00 | 15% | 15% | 24 | Yes |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 750.00 | 15% | 20% | 24 | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Installation credit**: a member credit applied to a replacement installation contract signed while the agreement is active.
- **Accessory discount**: a percentage off accessories added to an installation contract.
- **Duct cleaning discount**: a percentage off the whole-home duct cleaning task.
- **Repair guarantee extension**: whole months added to Harbison's standard repair guarantee for repairs done while the agreement is active.
- **Claim fee waiver**: whether the member's protection contract claim service fee is waived.

## Benefit questions answered from the table

**Which tiers waive the protection contract claim service fee?** Comfort Club Gold, Comfort Club Platinum, Comfort Club Platinum Plus and Comfort Club Total Home. Comfort Club Basic and Comfort Club Silver do not.

**On Comfort Club Basic, is any of these benefits available?** No: every figure on that row is 0 or "No".

**Hypothetical:** a Comfort Club Gold member signs a replacement installation contract while the agreement is active — the member installation credit for that tier is 250.00 USD, and accessories added to the contract carry a 10% discount.
